scope: Future unpublished publication-media encoding guard; no application, version, tag, released media or archive change
state: Implemented and focused tests passed; not released
implementation: Extension must match encoded PNG, JPEG or single-frame WebP signature and bounded container framing
PNG chunk CRC, image header and required data/end checks; JPEG segment/frame/scan/end checks; WebP RIFF/chunk/frame checks
Selected screenshot and all supported raster files in this candidate media namespace are checked, including unselected and nested mobile captures
Selected reused historical media is checked; unrelated frozen historical media is not rescanned or rewritten
No grandfather exception, dependency addition, image decoding, file conversion or publishing privilege change
limits: This guard inspects encoded container framing; it does not prove compressed pixel validity, visual correctness, rights or operational acceptance
WebP screenshot input is limited to a single frame; animated WebP is rejected
32MiB maximum per raster and512 selected/candidate raster files
Full suite, CI, exact installation and any distinct future release remain pending
